title: Voters Confirm Austin MUD Dissolution
summary:
*   Officials formally certified the results of the November 3, 1998 special election.
*   The election outcomes confirmed public approval for dissolving Austin's Municipal Utility Districts (MUDs) 1, 2, and 3.
*   The meeting was brief, concluding by 10:15 a.m. after addressing this single item.
transcript:
Austin City Council
MINUTES
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING
NOVEMBERS, 1998
Mayor Watson called the meeting to order.
Canvass results of City Special Municipal Election of November 3, 1998. Approved Canvass
results of City Special Municipal Election for Austin MUD 1, 2 & 3 Dissolution held on
November 3, 1998.
Approved
Items 1 and 2 approved as read on Councilmember Garcia's motion, Councilmember Slusher's
second, 4-0 vote, Mayor Pro Tern Goodman, Councilmembers Lewis and Spelman absent.
ADJOURNED at 10:15 a.m. on Councilmember Garcia's motion, Councilmember Slusher's second,
4-0 vote, Mayor Pro Tern Goodman, Councilmembers Lewis and Spelman absent.
These minutes were approved on April 15, 1999 on Council Member Griffith's motion, Mayor
Pro Tern Goodman's second by a 6-0 vote. Council Member Garcia was off the dais.
